workoutItems.description:
Execution Notes:

Use a controlled negative (don't free fall) and then explode on the positive.

Protocol Details:

  • Rest: 2-3 min
  • Warm-up Sets: 2-4
  • Last-Set Intensity Technique: Failure

Substitution Options:

  • Sled 45° Leg Press
  • Dumbbell Walking Lunge

Execution Notes:

Lean forward over the machine to get a maximum stretch in your hamstrings.

Protocol Details:

  • Rest: 1-2 min
  • Warm-up Sets: 1-2
  • Last-Set Intensity Technique: Failure + LLPs (Extend set)

Substitution Options:

  • Lever Lying Leg Curl
  • Nordic Ham Curl

Execution Notes:

Take medium strides. Minimize contribution from the back leg

Protocol Details:

  • Rest: 2-3 min
  • Warm-up Sets: 2-3
  • Last-Set Intensity Technique: Failure

Substitution Options:

  • Smith Rear Lunge
  • Dumbbell Rear Lunge

Execution Notes:

Set the seat back as far as it will go while still feeling comfortable. Grab the handles as hard as you can to pull your butt down into the seat. Use a 2-3 second negative. Feel your quads pulling apart on the negative.

Protocol Details:

  • Rest: 1-2 min
  • Warm-up Sets: 1-2
  • Last-Set Intensity Technique: Myo-reps

Substitution Options:

  • Reverse Nordic
  • Sissy Squat

Execution Notes:

Mind-muscle connection with your inner thighs. These are great for adding thigh mass from the front! Push them hard!

Protocol Details:

  • Rest: 1-2 min
  • Warm-up Sets: 1-2
  • Last-Set Intensity Technique: Failure

Substitution Options:

  • Cable Hip Adduction
  • Copenhagen Hip Adduction

Execution Notes:

If possible, use pads to increase the range of motion on the machine. Lean forward and grab onto the machine rails to stretch the glutes further.

Protocol Details:

  • Rest: 1-2 min
  • Warm-up Sets: 1-2
  • Last-Set Intensity Technique: Failure

Substitution Options:

  • Cable Hip Abduction
  • Lateral Band Walk

Execution Notes:

1-2 second pause at the bottom of each rep. Instead of just going up onto your toes, think about rolling your ankle back and forth on the balls of your feet.

Protocol Details:

  • Rest: 1-2 min
  • Warm-up Sets: 1-2
  • Last-Set Intensity Technique: Static Stretch (30s)

Substitution Options:

  • Lever Seated Calf Raise
  • Sled 45° Calf Raise (plate loaded)
